title: VOXPRIVACY: A BENCHMARK FOR EVALUATING INTERACTIONAL PRIVACY OF SPEECH LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a balanced two-turn dialogue test set where the second turn comes from the same speaker 50% of the time and a different speaker the other 50%, and calculating the cross-speaker error contribution to measure performance degradation when the speaker changes (referred to as 'Speaker Continuity Bias').

Evaluating and comparing model performance metrics (Accuracy, F1-score, and Invalid Response Rate) on identical interactional privacy tasks across English and Chinese language datasets to identify multi-lingual performance disparities.
